nodes.description: mapping(address => mapping(bytes32 => ProposalDetails)) public proposals; stores all NFT tribute proposals handled by each DAO.
receive() external payable fallback that reverts with 'fallback revert' to prevent ether being sent to the contract.
configureDao(DaoRegistry dao) external onlyAdapter(dao); registers the DAO internal token UNITS with the DAO Bank.
submitProposal(...) external reentrancyGuard(dao); creates and sponsors a tribute proposal, resolves sponsor via voting contract getSenderAddress and stores proposal details.
processProposal(DaoRegistry dao, bytes32 proposalId) external reentrancyGuard(dao); after a passed vote collects the NFT via the NFT extension and mints/bank-credits UNITS to the applicant.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller; used in onlyAdapter checks, reentrancyGuard lock flow and the voting contract sender resolution.
External call to NFTExtension.collect(nftAddr, nftTokenId) which performs erc721.safeTransferFrom, invoking an untrusted receiver callback (potential reentrancy).
External call to BankExtension.addToBalance(applicant, UNITS, requestAmount) that credits the applicant with the requested DAO internal tokens.
External call to IVoting.getSenderAddress(dao, address(this), data, msg.sender) used to derive the proposal sponsor; attacker-influenced external call.
External state-changing call in the reentrancyGuard modifier (dao.lockSession()/dao.unlockSession()) that sets the DAO lockedAt session keyed to block.number.
Function parameter dao (DaoRegistry) used by configureDao, submitProposal and processProposal.
Function parameter proposalId (bytes32) identifying the tribute proposal.
Function parameter applicant (address) receiving DAO internal tokens and membership; validated with isNotReservedAddress.
Function parameter nftAddr (address) of the ERC-721 token transferred to the DAO as tribute.
Function parameter nftTokenId (uint256) identifier of the tribute NFT.
Function parameter requestAmount (uint256) amount of DAO internal tokens (UNITS) requested.
Function parameter data (bytes) forwarded to the voting adapter calls.
Local ProposalDetails storage reference proposal in processProposal read from the proposals mapping.
Local IVoting.VotingState voteResult returned by votingContract.voteResult and used to branch the payout logic.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed into votingContract.getSenderAddress to derive sponsoredBy, so the caller controls the sponsor identity of the proposal.
onlyAdapter(dao) validates msg.sender via dao.state()/dao.isAdapter, making the caller the access-control subject of configureDao.
processProposal relies on reentrancyGuard(dao) and adapter state checks that depend on msg.sender before releasing funds.
submitProposal writes the new ProposalDetails entry into the proposals mapping.
processProposal reads the stored ProposalDetails (nftAddr, nftTokenId, applicant, requestAmount) from the proposals mapping.
submitProposal makes an external call to the untrusted voting adapter getSenderAddress before completing its state updates.
processProposal performs the external NFT collect call (erc721.safeTransferFrom) which hands control to an untrusted NFT contract/receiver.
processProposal forwards proposal.requestAmount to bank.addToBalance to credit the applicant with UNITS.
The reentrancyGuard on processProposal calls dao.lockSession()/dao.unlockSession() to gate reentry around the payout.
The reentrancyGuard on submitProposal calls dao.lockSession()/dao.unlockSession() to gate reentry during proposal creation.

normalization_plan.reason: The dao parameter is the registry object dereferenced throughout processProposal (voting adapter, extensions, processProposal call) and should be folded into that core function.
proposalId is the key under which submitProposal stores the proposal and is consumed directly by that core function.
applicant is validated with isNotReservedAddress and stored into the proposals mapping inside submitProposal.
nftAddr is passed directly as the NFT contract argument of the collect unsafe external call.
nftTokenId is passed directly as the token identifier argument of the collect unsafe external call.
requestAmount is the amount argument forwarded to the bank.addToBalance unsafe external call.
data is forwarded unchanged to the voting adapter getSenderAddress external call.
The storage pointer proposal exists only inside processProposal and is merged into that core function.
voteResult is computed and branched on only inside processProposal, so it merges into that core function.
